# Is your 1099 contractor legally an employee?

> Free worker classification checker for small business owners. Screen a contractor against the IRS test, the DOL economic reality test and the ABC test, see which facts point to employee status and estimate back-tax and overtime exposure. Illustrative; nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
